\textbf{A013 --- Representation stability.} Study how a useful ordered cover changes under a physical restriction, tensor product, or multiplexer composition. Bound the extra gates, label entropy, and changes in root probabilities explicitly.
\subsection{B04: Addressing and shared-data tests}

\emph{Acceptance tests.} Specify at each node which coordinates are fresh selectors and which are shared data; shared control variables require a new proof. Account for cross-level coefficient collisions and selector influence, instead of multiplying disjoint-composition formulas through reuse. Show an unbounded-depth or unbounded-arity regime beyond an already proved orthogonal-selector iteration, or identify why the candidate lies within that baseline.

\textbf{A018 --- Shared-data collision law.} Exploit the exact Walsh collision identity for arbitrary overlapping branches. Characterize when posterior label entropy cancels the selector alphabet cost and when coherent interference adds entropy.

\textbf{A019 --- Quantitative shared-data classes.} Start from the already proved implication $\I_{\rm sel}\ge ca\Rightarrow C_{\rm closure}=\max\{2/c,C\}$. Prove its hypothesis for a genuinely new family with unbounded arity or depth, or prove a sharper complete collision payment for an explicit structural class where $\I_{\rm sel}/a\to0$. Test the bent-splice obstruction before proposing a selector-only increment bound.
